title: Final Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The final temperature T must be correctly calculated as 1.71 x 10^5 K.

title: Induced Emission Equation
description: Important Criteria: The equation for the induced transition probability w_{12} must be correctly stated.

title: Spontaneous Emission Equation
description: Important Criteria: The equation for the spontaneous transition probability A_{12} must be correctly stated.

title: Equal Transition Probabilities
description: Important Criteria: The condition for equal probabilities of spontaneous and induced emissions must be derived correctly.

title: Black Body Radiation Density
description: Optional Criteria: The expression for the density of states rho(omega) in black body radiation should be included.

title: Temperature Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation leading to the expression for temperature T must be shown clearly.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any mistakes in units or dimensional analysis should be avoided.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in equations should be checked and corrected.
